name: Sunlu FilaDryer S2 3D Printer Filament Dryer Box
description: Selling a Sunlu FilaDryer S2 3D printer filament dehydrator storage box in good condition. Features a large 4.6-inch LCD touch screen monitor that accurately displays real-time temperature, timer countdown, current humidity level, and targeted filament presets. Built with upper and lower double heating plates providing 360-degree encircling heat up to 70°C, which perfectly dries sensitive materials like PLA, PETG, ABS, TPU, and Nylon to prevent stringing or clogging issues. Operates quietly and effectively. Shows normal light cosmetic desk usage wear but functions flawlessly. Power adapter is fully included.

name_zh: 三绿 SUNLU FilaDryer S2 3D打印耗材干燥盒
description_zh: 出一台成色良好的三绿 SUNLU FilaDryer S2 3D打印耗材防潮烘干盒。配备 4.6 英寸大尺寸 LCD 触控屏，可实时显示温度、倒计时、环境湿度并支持一键切换材质预设。采用上下双加热板设计，提供 360 度环绕加热，最高温可达 70°C，能有效解决 PLA、PETG、ABS、TPU 及尼龙拉丝或堵头问题。运行静音。外观有正常轻微桌面使用痕迹，功能完全完好，附带原装电源适配器。
